_what_this_is: Instructions the CLIENT has given, which are not calls the desk has made. They are applied on top of the published calls and are labelled differently everywhere they appear, because a Sell on an Ionic page reads as the firm's verdict and this is not one. Nothing here changes the score file; it is a per-client overlay and it travels with this client's build only.
instruction: The client has asked to exit the fixed-income sleeve and redeploy the proceeds into the growth-oriented construct.

directives.reason: Directed by the client, not a call on the scheme. The desk's own view on these holdings is unchanged; the money is being moved to fund the growth allocation.
Cannot be exited on request: a fifteen-year term with one partial withdrawal a year from year seven. Tax-free on maturity, so there is no tax reason to touch it either.

Age-gated at 60 and running a fixed five-year term. Premature closure forfeits 1% to 1.5% of the deposit and the rate cannot be bought back. Held in a parent's name and doing a job the equity sleeve cannot.
Surrender terms depend on the premium against the sum assured and on when the policy was written; a deduction already claimed can be reversed. The policy document is needed before any exit is priced.

footnote: Client-directed exits are shown separately from the desk's Sell calls throughout this review. Nothing is executed until the client authorises it.
